name: claw-squad
description: 3-agent Claude orchestrator: Planner -> Coder -> Reviewer with self-learning memory. Inspired by openclaw (gateway + sandboxing) and OpenHarness (agent loop + hooks).
_otel: Set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to enable tracing. The OTel deps in optionalDependencies are dynamic-imported by src/tracing.ts; when absent, tracing falls back to no-op spans so the default install stays lean.
_mcp: `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` is dynamic-imported by src/mcp/server.ts so only `claw-squad mcp` users pay for it. Default installs stay lean.
